actions.label: measure files, bytes, and role runs per ticket, repeatably
choose the lane from facts the files hold, by a script
recompute the lane when facts change (plan written, Plan review appended)
record every skip and every lane decision where a check can find it
refuse to close or pass check on a lean or fix ticket lacking its skip entries, without failing tickets closed before the feature
never let a verifier share a family with any build it verifies, also when launched at the task dir
let the chain consume a whole-ticket verdict: next, resume, and board know a step is verified or needs re-verification
plan coarse steps: one per independently verifiable outcome, within the thresholds
warn, not refuse, when a lean-eligible plan exceeds the thresholds
replan by delta instead of rewriting the plan
refuse a delta that names a missing step
read one merged plan everywhere: split, lint, review, lane, the plan-reviewer, people
accept a delta at another level than its base (planner-L3.md revises planner-L2.md)
cite a settled decision by anchor instead of restating it in the step block
refuse a dangling anchor
write a fact once and have later roles read it before searching
keep generated Codex agents in parity after every contract change
resolve ticket dir, roadmap path, and notes path from one place
keep ids unique across worktrees and external branches under either layout
move an existing repo to topics in one idempotent command with a dry run and a dirty-tree refusal
keep cites readable after roadmap.md and notes.md move (file cites, not only folder cites)
leave flat repos untouched on upgrade: a check warning, no stale managed block
board, status line, traces, and fanout find tasks and notes under either layout
docs and skills print the paths a repo actually has
queue plan reviews of several tickets on one family (interactive multi-ticket case)
hold one open-questions round per ticket set
run lanes in parallel only when file sets are disjoint; serialize shared generated files by merge order
prove each new guard with a negative control that goes red
show the footprint reduction on a fixture ticket on both lanes and both hosts
split old plans unchanged: delta handling keyed on revises: presence, no version line
always run the filer on the lean lane
ask the user before recording a skip the lane does not permit
read the batching rule only after the family rule and the step-state rule exist

edges.why: lane may print lean only once chain has a lean lane; both edit steps.py and skills/chain
the skips.md line format is pinned by lane before the guard parses it
a task-dir verifier must be family-guarded before next may count its verdict
the conductor batching rule names the next rule, so it ships after it
same file steps.py; merge reroutes the shared plan_facts to the merged plan so lane and review read deltas
same file steps.py; anchors resolve against the merged plan's files
the reviewer rule names steps.py resolve, which must exist
migrate writes the layout key the resolver reads; same file tickets.py
same file fanout.py; the overlap check is layout-independent so it goes first
docs print the paths the migration makes final
the live run records footprint before and after
